blind.description: A rustic, rickety bridge walkway section or flat ladder composed of two sturdy side logs bound with tan rope lashings, supporting roughly cut dark weathered wooden planks. Planks are irregularly spaced and slightly angled to give a worn, makeshift appearance. Meshes and textures are solid, cohesive, and game-ready with no floating elements or distortion.
blind.from_above: Resembles a narrow wooden ladder or rope-tied gangway laid flat, with two vertical log rails and eight crosswise weathered planks tied on with rope.
blind.height_vs_figure: Very low to the ground (under 1 ft tall); roughly 2.5 ft wide and approximately 10 to 12 ft long (nearly twice the length of the 5 ft 9 in figure).
